content:
Alex (CS): heads-up  HelioBiotics renewal. procurement wants to split the invoice across two entities (EU entity pays VAT-exempt portion, US entity covers subscription). they sent two provisional PO numbers but asked if we can issue split invoices. missing: signed PO for each entity, legal names for invoicing, SOW confirmation. looping @Maya @Greg @Vera
Maya (Sales): buyer DM: they need two invoices so they can map to different GL accounts. provided POs: PO-EU-443 (pending signature) and PO-US-998 (signed but missing GL). asked if we can accept a single payment by card now and later allocate credits across invoices.
Greg (Legal): legal note: split billing across entities is ok but requires an intercompany billing addendum referencing both POs and stating which entity is responsible for which seats. we should not accept a card payment on behalf of two legal entities without addendum. i can draft a 2-line addendum for their CFO to sign.
Vera (Ops): ops needs explicit seat allocation per entity and the SOW updated to reflect split billing. also need billing emails and exact legal names as they appear in registry. provisional vendor IDs are insufficient for ERP mapping.
Alex (CS): paste procurement DM:
```
PO-EU-443 (unsigned)
Bill To: HelioBiotics EU SARL
Seats covered: 60
VAT: reverse-charge claimed

PO-US-998 (signed)
Bill To: HelioBiotics Inc
Seats covered: 40
GL: 5200-Cloud
```
Alex (CS): buyer says treasury can run a single card for the total now and we can re-allocate via internal credit notes once POs are fully processed.
finance-bot: draft invoice INV-HB-900 total USD 86,000 (EUR portion to be computed)  status: draft, missing split allocation and SOW. link: https://finance.internal/INV-HB-900
Maya (Sales): recommendation: accept card for full amount only if buyer signs intercompany addendum acknowledging allocation and promising signed POs within 10 business days. ops/legal must agree.
Greg (Legal): ok to proceed if addendum includes: 1) which entity is primary payer 2) commitment to deliver signed PO-EU-443 and confirmation of reverse-charge within 10 business days 3) explicit acceptance that Seller will issue two invoices and adjust ledger via credit/debit once POs arrive. i'll draft and send to buyer by EOD.
Vera (Ops): ops will provision seats upon cleared payment but will tag accounts: HelioBiotics-EU (60 seats pending VAT cert) and HelioBiotics-US (40 seats live). no production keys for EU seats until VAT doc attached.
Alex (CS): buyer asked if a signed board resolution is needed for EU payments. i told them addendum + PO will suffice.
Maya (Sales): i'll escalate to buyer CFO to get addendum signed quickly. Alex please include the ledger mapping in the customer-facing email.
Alex (CS): customer-facing message queued: "We can accept single payment if you sign the intercompany addendum (attached) and supply signed EU PO + VAT doc within 10 business days. We'll issue two invoices and reconcile with credits if needed." sending now.
billing-bot: created proforma PRO-HB-900 for card capture scheduled at 09:00 UTC tomorrow if signed addendum not received by midnight UTC.
Greg (Legal): action items: i'll send addendum + copy to our accounting team. include clause about VAT reverse-charge evidence (VAT cert or intra-EU OSS proof).
Vera (Ops): ops checklist: [ ] signed PO-EU-443 (pdf) [ ] VAT certificate (pdf) [ ] signed PO-US-998 (pdf) [ ] updated SOW with seat split. will mark when done.
Alex (CS): timeline: if addendum + EU PO arrive by Friday EOD, proceed with split invoicing and no card capture. if not, we'll attempt card capture and route addendum for signature. will update thread when buyer responds. :thumbsup:
